scripts.update: npm run content:render && npm run resume:build
scripts.resume:build: mkdir -p resume/.build && latexmk -cd -xelatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error -outdir=.build resume/George_Stepaniants_CV.tex && cp resume/.build/George_Stepaniants_CV.pdf resume/George_Stepaniants_CV.pdf
scripts.check: npm run content:check && node --check assets/js/data.js && node --check assets/js/main.js && node --check assets/js/contact-form.js
